summary_en: 257,000 shares (1.76% of shares outstanding) up to ¥900M, ceiling price not disclosed, open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 3–Oct 31, 2026. To enable flexible capital allocation in response to operating conditions.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Godo Steel's board resolved on 31 July 2026 to acquire up to 257,000 treasury shares (1.76% of the 14.62 million shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥900 million. The shares will be acquired by open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from 3 August 2026 through 31 October 2026. No price ceiling per share is disclosed. The company states the acquisition is to enable flexible capital allocation responsive to operating conditions. The acquisition is authorized under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation.
